messages:
maya: Heads-up — vendor just sent a pre-notice for planned maintenance on their eu-west1 rack. Window: 2026-03-28 02:00-08:00 UTC. They warned there may be a 4-6h outage. Can we borrow H100s from partners or shift any critical workloads out of eu-west1? Ticket VND-4821: https://vendor.example/tickets/VND-4821

vendor-ops-bot: Ticket VND-4821 updated: maintenance window acknowledged by vendor. ETA/impact TBD.

liam: Can we spill capacity to us-west2 for the hot paths? Our us-west2 quota might be enough for routing non-iso traffic. @jess do you see spare quota in prod account?

jess: Prod quota is pretty tight right now — only 4 spare H100s sitting in demo pool that we can repurpose short-term. Finance sign-off needed if we go above that. :thinking:

omar: I can approve up to 4 from my side for an emergency borrow. For >4 we need a quick finance approval (cc: @maya). Also opening a PR would help track change and approvals: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/412

maya: PR created and linked in the ticket. Summary: request 6 H100s in eu-west1 for 8 hours, fallback routing to us-west2 for non-sensitive traffic. Terraform snippet I added to the PR for the temporary borrow:

```
resource "redwood_quota_borrow" "temp_h100" {
  region         = "eu-west1"
  gpu_model      = "h100"
  count          = 6
  duration_hours = 8
  reason         = "vendor maintenance failover"
}
```

jess: Also opened an emergency network route to reduce cross-region latency for shifted traffic (short-term): `route set --from=apac --to=eu-west1 --max=200mbps` — not ideal but reduces pressure on remaining eu capacity.

liam: Filing cloud support now to request a short quota bump for eu-west1 while vendor maintenance is active. Support ticket CLD-8709 created, referencing VND-4821. If support approves quickly, we can avoid draining demo pool.

omar: If procurement or support is delayed, we should enable smart-routing policy to shift model variants to smaller compute tiers automatically. Quick canary I can kick off: `rollout --policy=canary --traffic=10% --route=us-west2`

maya: Sounds good. @oncall can you monitor vendor ticket and be ready to execute the PR merge + Terraform apply during the maintenance window? I'll update the status board and add a runbook section for this incident. :thumbsup:

oncall: Acknowledged — will monitor overnight and ping when we start the apply.

maya: Thanks everyone — will post updates in VND-4821 and the ops PR.
